Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers

for Service Support. 6. M/s Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) issues this Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) for Supply an d Installation of LED Screen, Televisions, UPS Systems & Batteries, Voltage Stabilizer, Speakers and Associ ated Accessories at HPCL GMO, South Zone Office, Chennai. SCHEDULE OF QUANTITIES Item No. Item Title Quantity UOM Supply of LED Screen In 1 200 Sq.ft door 2 LED Screen Controller 1 Each Transport, Installation & Structural Fabrication 3 1 Lumpsum of LED Screens and Acc essories 4 SITC of 5 kVA Stabilizer 1 Each 5 SITC of 3 Core Cable 40 Running Meter 6 SITC of 20A MCB 4 Each Supply & Installation of 7 75 Running Meter CAT6 Cable Supply & Installation of 8 1 Set Speaker Set Supply & Installation of 9 3 Each Television - 43 Inch 6 kVA Online UPS - 120 10 1 Each V DC (1 Phase) 12V DC Batteries - 26A 11 1 Each h 10 kVA Online UPS - 24 12 1 Each 0V DC (1 Phase) 12V DC Batteries - 42A 13 1 Each h

Transportation & Install 14 ation of UPS 1 Each Supply & Installation of 15 2 Each Television - 55 Inch The quoted prices shall include packing, forwarding, transportation, unloading, installation, testing, commi ssioning and all incidental charges required for complete execution, as applicable. GST shall be indicated/c onsidered as per the GeM bid requirements. The quantities indicated are approximate. Payment shall be made only for quantities actually ordered, sup plied, installed where applicable, and accepted by HPCL. HOW TO QUOTE Bidders shall quote against all applicable line items in the GeM financial bid in accordance with the BOQ. T he quoted amount for each line item shall cover the full scope, quantity and all associated obligations stat ed in the tender documents. No price information shall be disclosed in the technical bid. DELIVERY, INSTALLATION AND CONTRACT VALIDITY The entire equipment and accessories shall be delivered within one (1) month from the date of Letter of In tent/Purchase Order. Installation, testing and commissioning shall be completed within the next one (1) m onth from the date of receipt of material/equipment at site. The Purchase Order/Letter of Award shall remain valid for two (2) months from the date of issue, subject to the delivery and completion requirements specified in the tender. The Liquidated Damages clause : Supply shall be completed within 1 MONTH from the Release Order. Del ivery date will be considered as actual date of material receipt at site. For any delay beyond delivery date, price reduction will be applicable as per the rules of corporatio n. INSTALLATION AND COMMISSIONING All accessories, wall-mounting brackets, screws, cables, connectors, structures and other materials require d for complete installation and commissioning shall be in the vendor's scope. The vendor shall depute qual ified personnel and provide all labour, tools, tackles, fixtures and lifting equipment. Work on Sundays/holid ays may be required as per site requirements, without additional payment. Free water and electricity, as a vailable, will be provided at one designated point. WARRANTY AND REPLACEMENT All materials shall be brand-new, unused, of current manufacture and compliant with the offered and appr oved make/model and tender specifications. The LED screen shall carry a minimum three-year comprehen sive onsite warranty. Televisions shall carry a minimum one-year comprehensive manufacturer's warranty. Warranty for UPS systems, batteries and other items shall be as specified in the tender/BOQ and the manu facturer's warranty documents. Any defective, damaged, substandard or non-conforming material shall be replaced within seven (7) days of written notification, at no additional cost to HPCL. HPCL may recover the material cost together with the applicable contractual penalty and take action under the security deposit/performance security provisions if replacement is not completed. EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD) EMD APPLICABLE - Rs. 77,000/- (Rupees Seventy-Seven Thousand Only). Bids received without EMD or vali d exemption documents, as applicable under tender/GeM conditions, are liable for rejection. SECURITY DEPOSIT / PERFORMANCE SECURITY The successful bidder shall submit Security Deposit equal to 2% of the Purchase Order/Contract value. Perf

ormance Security/Composite Performance Bank Guarantee/Insurance Surety Bond and retention money pr ovisions shall apply as specified in the tender documents and applicable HPCL terms. PAYMENT TERMS No advance payment shall be made. Seventy percent (75%) payment will be processed upon delivery of t he items at HPCL GMO, South Zone Office, Chennai. Twenty-five percent (25%) payment will be processed after successful installation, testing and commissioning of the items, subject to certification and submissio n of the required invoice and supporting documents. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES For delay attributable to the supplier, Liquidated Damages shall be levied at 0.5% of the basic value of the undelivered quantity for every week or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 5% of the basic value of the undelivered quantity, excluding taxes, duties, levies, freight and other charges. For fractional days, LD sha ll apply on a pro-rata basis, subject to the final confirmed delivery period. TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE DOCUMENTS Bidders shall submit the signed technical compliance confirmation, make and model details, manufacturer' s product datasheets, warranty details and supporting documents required by the tender. OEM-authorised bidders shall submit a valid manufacturer authorization. Other eligible suppliers shall submit the experienc e and completion/performance documents stipulated in the tender. GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS Scope of work, technical specifications, payment details and detailed terms and conditions are provided in the tender attachments. Bidders shall read the complete tender package and quote accordingly. All manda ted declarations and documents shall be signed and uploaded with the bid. HPCL terms and conditions sha ll supersede in case of conflict, unless otherwise expressly specified. Note: Open all tender documents using the latest version of Adobe Acrobat for proper viewing.
